Description: Field trial at the Northfield research farm, on a field of mostly sandy loam that grew spring barley the year before. Split-plot design with 2 blocks: water regime is the main-plot factor and line the subplot factor, so each block has one main plot per water regime, with both lines in it. Each block is one row of plots running across the slope of the field. Each plot has 4 rows of plants, sown at 45 seeds per square metre. The levels of the water regime are defined in ExperimentIntervention. Weather data come from the weather station of the farm, and soil water content from sensors in some of the plots.
Comments: A hailstorm on 2025-06-14 damaged leaves and flowers across the whole field.

Description: Pot experiment in a greenhouse compartment at the Northfield research farm, comparing lines with no factors tested. Each pot is filled with a peat-based potting mix and sown with 3 seeds. The compartment has 16 hours of light a day and is heated to 20 degrees Celsius by day and 15 degrees Celsius at night, and the pots are watered by hand to keep the soil moist. The pots stand on one bench in a completely randomised layout, with 2 pots per line and no blocks. Climate data come from the sensor of the compartment.
